input.query: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_shipped, MAX(delivered_ts) AS max_delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_delivered FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier

final_answer.basis: shipments 只有 shipped_ts 與 delivered_ts，沒有承諾送達日或 SLA 欄位；語意層搜尋「準時」「送達」「SLA」「配送時效」皆無對應定義。承運商代碼為 blackcat（黑貓），可對應到 shipments.carrier，但準時的判定標準缺失，需由業務方提供承諾時效後才能計算。
